source_refs.note: Book p. 56: 2.11 Local Linear Approximation (Linearization), introduction before 2.11.1

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Aaj hum differentiation ka ek bohat practical use seekhne ja rahe hain. Ab tak aap ne derivative nikalna seekha, tangent line ki equation nikalna seekha. Ab sawal yeh hai ke is sab ka faida kya hai? Is section ka jawab hai: mushkil functions ki values andaze se, lekin kaafi sahi, nikalna.

Kitab kehti hai: kabhi kabhi complicated (pecheeda) functions ke saath kaam karna mushkil hota hai, is liye hum unhein approximate karne (qareeb qareeb value dene) ke liye simple functions use karte hain. Yeh approximations aksar practical kaamon ke liye kaafi accurate hoti hain.
Is section mein hum linearization parhenge. Linearization tangent lines use kar ke kisi function ko ek khaas point ke qareeb approximate karti hai.

Linearization complex ya nonlinear (jo seedhi line na ho) functions ko ek straight line se approximate kar ke calculation aasaan bana deti hai. Machine learning, physics, engineering aur economics mein is ka bohat use hota hai, jab kisi maloom value ke aas paas chhoti si tabdeeli ka jaldi andaza lagana ho.

Poora idea ek misaal se samjhiye. Zameen gol hai, lekin jab aap apne ghar ke saamne sarak par khare hote hain to woh bilkul seedhi (flat) lagti hai. Kyun? Kyun ke aap gol zameen ka bohat chhota sa hissa dekh rahe hain. Bilkul isi tarah kisi smooth curve ke ek point ke bohat qareeb zoom karein to curve takreeban seedhi line lagti hai. Woh seedhi line us point par tangent line hai.
Seedhi line ke saath hisaab bohat aasaan hai: sirf multiply aur add. Is liye us point ke qareeb hum curve ki jagah tangent line use kar lete hain.
Pehle se kya chahiye? Do cheezein: (1) \(f'(a)\) tangent ka slope hai \(x = a\) par; (2) point \((a, f(a))\) se guzarne wali line jis ka slope \(m\) ho: \(y = f(a) + m(x - a)\). Agle sabaq (2.11.1) mein yahi do baatein jor kar linearization banegi.
Kahan kaam aata hai? \(\sqrt{9.2}\), \(\sqrt[3]{82}\) ya \(\cos 91^\circ\) haath se nikalna mushkil hai, lekin \(\sqrt{9}\), \(\sqrt[3]{64}\) aur \(\cos 90^\circ\) to zubani yaad hain. Hum aasaan value se shuru karte hain aur tangent line humein chhota sa qadam aage mushkil value tak le jati hai.
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text:
Agar aap ko \(\sqrt{25.3}\) ka andaza lagana ho to aap kis aasaan value se shuru karenge, aur kyun?
(Jawab: \(\sqrt{25} = 5\) se, kyun ke 25 perfect square hai aur 25.3 us ke bohat qareeb hai. Agar \(\sqrt{36}\) se shuru karte to faasla bohat zyada hota aur andaza kamzor aata.)
blocks.title: Khud sochiye

blocks.text:
1. Mushkil function ko kisi point ke qareeb ek simple function, yani tangent line, se replace kiya ja sakta hai.
2. Yeh approximation local hai: sirf us point ke qareeb sahi kaam karti hai.
3. \(x\) jitna point ke qareeb ho, andaza utna behtar; door jayen to ghalti barh jati hai.
4. Science, engineering aur economics mein jaldi andaza lagane ke liye linearization bohat use hoti hai.
blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein

blocks.text:
1. Tangent line wali value ko bilkul exact samajh lena. Yeh sirf approximation hai, is liye \(\approx\) likhein, \(=\) nahi.
2. Tangent line ko us ke point se bohat door use karna: wahan curve line se door mur jati hai aur ghalti bohat barh jati hai.
